court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife deserted respondent-husband in 2017 and treated him with cruelty; respondent-husband filed petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act; wife resisted by filing counter; husband seeks to amend original petition to change date of marriage and grounds for divorce.

legal_principles.principle: An application seeking amendment cannot be rejected merely on the ground that a wrong provision has been quoted by the parties.
legal_principles.held: Quoting a wrong provisions will not prejudice the right of any parties and therefore, an application seeking amendment cannot be rejected merely on the ground that a wrong provision has been quoted by the parties.

legal_principles.principle: The trial Court has rightly appreciated the pleading available in the original petition and allowed the amendment application.
legal_principles.held: However, the trial Court has rightly appreciated the pleading available in the original petition and allowed the amendment application.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order allowing the amendment petition was upheld, and the case was remanded back to the trial court.

use_for_drafting: responding to amendments in divorce cases
appealing against orders on desertion and cruelty
